commands.simple_tweaks.enchant.no_item: No item found in the selected slot(s) -- nothing to enchant
commands.simple_tweaks.enchant.unsupport: Warning: %s is not supported by %s of those item(s) (slot: %s) - the enchantment was written but will do nothing
commands.simple_tweaks.enchant.usage: Usage: /simple_tweaks enchant <targets> <enchantment> <level> [slot] -- level 0 removes; slot defaults to mainhand (alias: /fst)
death.attack.celestial_particle: %1$s was purified by the holy light
gui.simple_tweaks.config.disableEnchantm: Remove the enchanting table level cap
Mob gear carries mod enchantments (never drops them)
gui.simple_tweaks.config.barHealthHud: Health bar instead of vanilla hearts
gui.simple_tweaks.config.save_hint: Type a value and it applies at once (out-of-range values are clamped)
gui.simple_tweaks.enchant_info.title: Enchantment List
enchantment.simple_tweaks.acid_attack.de: Damages the target's held weapon on hit. Higher levels deal more durability damage.
Taking repeated damage of the same type builds up to 6 stacks of damage reduction. Each stack reduces incoming damage by 0.9%% per level; switching damage type or going 5 seconds without being hit resets the stacks.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.aoe_attack.des: On hit, if other attackable enemies are near the target, the damage is split among all of them. The total damage pool is the original hit multiplied by the level, capped at 100%% per enemy. Higher levels cover larger groups and keep more damage on each target.
Damages a random piece of the target's armor on hit. Higher levels deal more durability damage.
Reduces the damage you take by an amount derived from your armour points and armour toughness -- the square root of each, both multiplied by the enchantment level -- so better armour helps more, with diminishing returns.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.assassin.desc: Instantly executes targets whose health is below a threshold after the hit. The threshold scales with level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.auto_smelt.des: Blocks drop their furnace-smelted result directly when mined. Conflicts with Silk Touch. Works with Fortune. Supports both furnace and blast-furnace recipes; when both exist the blast-furnace product wins.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.blessing_exten: Each tick there is a 5%% x level chance to extend every beneficial status effect you have by 1 tick.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.bloodlust.desc: Increases damage based on the attacker's missing health. Higher levels improve the bonus.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.celestial_bles: A share (18%% x level) of the damage dealt heals you, and the same amount feeds a holy shield (the shield grows from damage dealt, not from overheal) Also +2.5 base attack damage per level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.chain_lightnin: Hitting a target charges it. Hitting a charged target arcs lightning to up to 1 + level/2 enemies within 3 + level blocks, each taking 30%% + 10%% x level of the hit's damage. (The arc is lightning damage and leaves a lightning mark.)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.charged_strike: Each hit stores a portion of its damage. Your next hit releases the stored damage as bonus. Released damage is never stored again. Higher levels store more per hit.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.clear_sight.de: Removes blindness and darkness while worn, and keeps night vision active, renewing it before it fades.
Consecutive hits on the same target build up a combo. Each stack adds 2%% x level bonus damage, up to a maximum of 20%% x level. Taking any damage or switching targets resets the combo. The combo also expires after 5 seconds without attacking.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.combo.desc: Consecutive hits shorten the target's i-frames (-10%% per level) and grant +35%% x level attack speed; at level X the invulnerability window is cancelled entirely
enchantment.simple_tweaks.crit.desc: Grants a chance to perform a critical hit even when not jumping. Higher levels increase the chance.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.crit_damage.de: Increases the damage of critical hits. Higher levels provide more bonus.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.curse_resistan: Each tick there is a 5%% x level chance to shorten every harmful status effect on you by 1 tick, removing it once it runs out.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.damage_limiter: Reduces incoming hits to a percentage of your max health. Damage above a higher threshold pierces through. Higher levels increase both the reduction and the pierce threshold.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.damage_reducti: Reduce the percentage of damage you take
enchantment.simple_tweaks.dark_conversio: Converts 1.5%% x level (max 7.5%%) of the hit into dark damage: that share is removed from the original hit, re-dealt as dark, and half of it is added again. Mutually exclusive with every other conversion. Fits swords, bows and crossbows; arrow hits convert and react exactly like melee.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.dark_protectio: Reduces incoming dark damage by 4%% per level per worn armour piece, up to 80%% total.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.death_protecti: When taking fatal damage, consumes one level of the enchantment to negate the hit and grants absorption equal to the original level x 20. Higher levels grant more absorption and allow more triggers before the enchantment is used up.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.delayed_recove: A portion of damage taken is returned to you as healing over the next few seconds. Death cancels all pending recovery.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.double_crit.de: When you score a critical hit, has a chance to deal extra damage. Higher levels increase the chance and damage.
Every attack has a chance to trigger an extra strike.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.echo_shield.de: Each hit you take is mitigated by 3%% x level (total level capped at 20, i.e. 60%% max). The mitigated portion is stored in an Echo Buffer. When the buffer meets or exceeds an incoming hit, that hit is fully negated and the entire buffer is reflected back to the attacker. The attacker that got blocked cannot be healed for the next level ticks (at most 5 ticks = 0.25 s). The buffer is cleared on death. (The returned damage keeps the element that hit you and ignores armour.)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.echo_shot.desc: Arrow hits echo on the target after a short delay, dealing bonus damage. Higher levels echo for more damage and shorter delay.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.effect_bonus.d: Increases damage based on the number of active potion effects on the target. Higher levels improve the multiplier.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_mast: Elemental conversion damage +10%% per level; transformative reaction damage +8%% per level
enchantment.simple_tweaks.execute.desc: Deals bonus damage proportional to the target's missing health. Higher levels increase the percentage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.experience_ste: Add your experience base on your damage
enchantment.simple_tweaks.extra_armor.de: Provides extra armor point and armor toughness
enchantment.simple_tweaks.fast_bow.desc: Reduces bow draw time. Higher levels draw faster.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.fire_conversio: Converts 1.5%% x level (max 7.5%%) of the hit into fire damage: that share is removed from the original hit, re-dealt as fire, and half of it is added again. Mutually exclusive with every other conversion. Fits swords, bows and crossbows; arrow hits convert and react exactly like melee.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.fire_master.de: Increases damage based on the target's remaining burn time. Attacks extend the target's burning duration and grant you Fire Resistance. Higher levels burn longer and hit harder.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.fire_protectio: Reduces incoming fire damage by 4%% per level per worn armour piece, up to 80%% total.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.flight.desc: Allows the wearer to fly, but consumes hunger and durability over time. Higher levels reduce consumption.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.frost_conversi: Converts 1.5%% x level (max 7.5%%) of the hit into frost damage: that share is removed from the original hit, re-dealt as frost, and half of it is added again. Mutually exclusive with every other conversion. Fits swords, bows and crossbows; arrow hits convert and react exactly like melee.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.frost_protecti: Reduces incoming frost damage by 4%% per level per worn armour piece, up to 80%% total.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.frostbite.desc: Hits stack Frostbite (one slowness level each, capped at 4); at 10 stacks the target is frozen in place for 2 s and the stacks reset
Slowly generates absorption hearts while worn. Absorption caps at 4 points per total armor level. Extra absorption from other sources is preserved.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.gravity_strike: Increases damage based on how far you have fallen. The higher you drop from, the harder you hit, up to a cap. No bonus from a flat jump. Releasing the strike mid-air keeps the momentum until you land.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.grievous_wound: Reduces the target's healing received by 20%% per level for 1+0.25 * lvl seconds. At level V the target cannot heal at all. Stacks from multiple hits refresh the duration but do not add up.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.healer.desc: Converts damage dealt into healing for the target, canceling the damage and restoring health.
Heals the attacker for a portion of damage dealt, with overflow turning into absorption. Higher levels improve healing.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.heavenly_punis: Grants a large bonus to final damage dealt. The struck target is weakened against you, briefly frozen in place, and its attack speed is crushed. Calls down a bolt of divine lightning on every hit. Higher levels increase damage, weaken enemies further, and extend the effect.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.healing_multip: +10%% per level of the incoming heal, plus a flat 0.25 per level
enchantment.simple_tweaks.hunters_mark.d: Arrow hits mark the target for 10 seconds. The next damage of any type dealt to the marked target is increased by 20%% per level, then the mark is consumed. Re-applying refreshes the duration and keeps the highest level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.immortal.desc: Grants a chance to completely negate incoming damage after accumulating hits. Higher levels increase the chance and negate more consecutive hits.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.infinite_power: Grants flight, invincibility, instant mining, infinite food and durability, laser attack, multiplied loot, soul-bound items, and an infinite storage bag.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.item_fixer.des: Slowly repairs the item over time. Conflicts with Mending.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.kill_aura.desc: While holding this weapon, automatically attack the nearest enemy nearby. Each attack consumes one durability. Higher levels increase range and reduce cooldown.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.light_conversi: Converts 1.5%% x level (max 7.5%%) of the hit into light damage: that share is removed from the original hit, re-dealt as light, and half of it is added again. Mutually exclusive with every other conversion. Fits swords, bows and crossbows; arrow hits convert and react exactly like melee.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.light_protecti: Reduces incoming light damage by 4%% per level per worn armour piece, up to 80%% total.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.lightning_conv: Converts 1.5%% x level (max 7.5%%) of the hit into lightning damage: that share is removed from the original hit, re-dealt as lightning, and half of it is added again. Mutually exclusive with every other conversion. Fits swords, bows and crossbows; arrow hits convert and react exactly like melee.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.lightning_prot: Reduces incoming lightning damage by 4%% per level per worn armour piece, up to 80%% total.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.magic_protecti: Reduces magic damage from potions, evoker fangs, wither, dragon breath, and sonic boom by 4%% per level per worn armor piece, up to 80%% total. Does not affect fire, frost, lightning, or explosion damage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.momentum.desc: Increases mining speed the longer you continuously mine the same block, up to +100%% * lvl.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.motion_bonus.d: Increases damage based on how fast you are moving relative to the target. Standing still gives no bonus; sprinting into an enemy maximizes it. Higher levels increase the maximum bonus.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.multishot.desc: Fires one additional arrow per level in a horizontal spread. Each arrow consumes one piece of ammunition. Arrows from Multishot do not reset the target's invulnerability window, allowing every arrow in the volley to land.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.nature_convers: Converts 1.5%% x level (max 7.5%%) of the hit into nature damage: that share is removed from the original hit, re-dealt as nature, and half of it is added again. Mutually exclusive with every other conversion. Fits swords, bows and crossbows; arrow hits convert and react exactly like melee.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.nature_protect: Reduces incoming nature damage by 4%% per level per worn armour piece, up to 80%% total.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.piercing_arrow: Arrows pierce through additional enemies equal to the enchantment level. Arrows still stick into blocks and can be picked up normally.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.prismatic_bles: Grants +4%% to all attributes (health, attack damage, attack speed, movement speed, armor and armor toughness etc.) per level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.reforge.desc: Disappears immediately upon being applied, resetting the item's prior work penalty. Used to clear the "Too Expensive" penalty from heavily worked items.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.regeneration.d: Slowly regenerates health over time. Higher levels restore more per interval.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.resilience.des: Reduces incoming damage the lower your health drops. No bonus at full health; with all four armor pieces at level III and health down to 10%%, the reduction reaches 84%%. Higher levels increase the reduction.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.saturation.des: Slowly restores hunger and saturation over time. Higher levels restore faster and more per trigger.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.sniper.desc: Arrows deal more damage the farther they have flown: +0.5%% per block per level, capped at 40 blocks (level V at full range = double damage).
enchantment.simple_tweaks.soul_bound.des: This item stays with you through death and returns to your inventory upon respawn.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.starfall.desc: Arrows mark the target and call down falling stars. Each star chases the target and explodes on impact, dealing area damage to nearby enemies. Higher levels summon more stars, with larger radius and higher damage. (The stars are fire damage and leave a fire mark.)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.swift_sneak.de: Increases your movement speed while sneaking. Higher levels make sneaking faster.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.tracking_arrow: Arrows gently curve towards the nearest enemy within 2+1×level blocks. Higher levels increase both the tracking range and the turning speed. Arrows stop tracking once they hit a block or pass through a wall.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.true_damage.de: A portion of your damage becomes true damage, bypassing the target's armor. Higher levels convert more of your damage.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.tunneling.desc: Breaking a block also destroys adjacent blocks of the same type. Level I affects blocks above and below, Level II expands to a cross shape, Level III covers a 3x3 plane. Sneaking disables the effect.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.venom.desc: Hits stack poison up to 10 times. Each stack deals 0.2 x level true damage per second, ignoring armour, Resistance and Protection. When the victim dies, half of the poison spreads to the nearest enemy. (Poison is nature damage and leaves a nature mark.)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.void_protectio: Teleports you back to y=256 when you fall into the void, and cancels that void damage
enchantment.simple_tweaks.water_conversi: Converts 1.5%% x level (max 7.5%%) of the hit into water damage: that share is removed from the original hit, re-dealt as water, and half of it is added again. Mutually exclusive with every other conversion. Fits swords, bows and crossbows; arrow hits convert and react exactly like melee.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.water_protecti: Reduces incoming water damage by 4%% per level per worn armour piece, up to 80%% total.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.simple_tweaks: 85 enchantments, 8 elements, mob levels and floating damage numbers
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.simple_tw:
128 custom enchantments, including 7 elemental conversions, 7 elemental affinities, elemental mastery and 17 element reactions.

Mobs get a level (and the health, attack and armour that come with it) scaled by how old the world is and how strong the player's whole loadout is. Their gear can carry this mod's enchantments, which are stripped before it drops.

Damage numbers are coloured per element, can be split into elemental / non-elemental halves, and always report the health that actually came off the bar.

Every command lives under /simple_tweaks (alias /fst).
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_ward: Reduces all elemental damage taken by 3%% per level (max 9%%), multiplying with single-element protection.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_reso: Increases transformative reaction damage by 10%% per level (max +30%%). Amplifying reaction multipliers are not affected — they scale the hit itself.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_pene: Ignores 8%% per level (max 24%%) of the target's elemental mitigation: protections, mob resistance and Elemental Ward.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_sigh: While worn, the action bar shows the element type and aura amount of whatever you look at
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_cata: Attachment ICD shortened by 0.5 s per level (2.5 -> 2.0 / 1.5 / 1.0 s) — the ceiling on reaction rate at high attack speed
enchantment.simple_tweaks.detonate.desc: On hit, if the target's aura is >= 2.0, consume all of it and deal aura x (2 + 0.5 x level) damage of that element (no reaction)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_spre: When a reaction fires, attach 0.5 x level of that element to other enemies within 2 + 0.5 x level blocks (aura only, no damage)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_echo: When you take elemental damage, attach min(0.3 x level, 1.0) of that element to yourself — getting hit becomes ammo for the next swing
enchantment.simple_tweaks.scavenger.desc: Killing a levelled mob has a level-scaled chance to drop extra vanilla materials; higher levels give better ones (iron nuggets below 20 / gold nuggets below 40 / iron ingot below 60 / emerald above)
At 5 stacks the collapse detonates for min(maxHP x (5%% + 5%% x level), accumulated x 2) as true damage (ignores armour, i-frames, never crits); other enemies within 3 + level blocks take 50%%. Each stack also makes the target take +12%% x level from you. Once per target per second
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_sove: The conversion element becomes whichever one actually reacts with the target's aura (falls back to your own conversion element when there is no aura); every reaction you trigger deals +30%% × level
enchantment.simple_tweaks.midas_touch.de: Block drops x(1 + 25%% x level) (multiplies with Fortune), mining speed +20%% x level, and a 35%% x level chance to drop 1 + level experience orbs. Mob drops and mob experience are untouched (those belong to Scavenger / Experience Stealer)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.extraction.des: Consumed on use: remove this item's highest-level enchantment and turn it into an enchantment book of the same level; the item keeps the rest. Cannot extract itself and never duplicates
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_attu: Consumed on use: replace the item's conversion enchantment with another random element, keeping the level. Nothing is consumed if the item has no conversion
enchantment.simple_tweaks.reroll.desc: Consumed on use: strip every mod enchantment from the item and roll 2 fresh ones that are legal for it (level 1 to half its max), never creating a conflicting pair. Vanilla enchantments are untouched
enchantment.simple_tweaks.infusion.desc: Consumed on use: spend 10 experience levels to raise the item's highest non-maxed enchantment by one level. Nothing is consumed when everything is maxed or you lack the levels
enchantment.simple_tweaks.reaction_casca: If the target already carries an aura, immediately resolve a reaction with the strongest element that reacts with it (ignoring the attachment ICD), feeding 40%% + 20%% × level of this hit into it. 0.5 s internal cooldown
enchantment.simple_tweaks.shockwave_land: Fall damage is halved, and a shockwave worth 25%% x level of it hits a 3 + level block radius (only falls past 3 blocks)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.aegis.desc: Raises the maximum absorption cap by +2 per level (+6 at level III), so Life Siphon / Echo Shield / Death Protection shields can actually hold their value (the vanilla cap defaults to 0)
A thrown trident strikes again for 40%% x level of the hit as lightning elemental damage (it can react); doubles in rain or when the target is in water, and in that case also leaves 1.0 lightning aura
enchantment.simple_tweaks.shield_breaker: An axe hit on a blocking target drops the block immediately (so the same hit lands unprotected) and costs 2 x level extra shield durability
enchantment.simple_tweaks.gale_elytra.de: Gliding pushes you along your heading (1.2%% per level, cap 5%%). Every 10 s, sneak while gliding to dash once, costing 3 x level elytra durability
enchantment.simple_tweaks.attunement.des: Each distinct enchantment on the weapon beyond Attunement itself (vanilla included) adds +2%% x level to final damage; several levels of one enchantment count once
enchantment.simple_tweaks.skyfall.desc: Holding the mace cancels fall damage; a hit made with at least 1.5 blocks of fall distance sends a shockwave worth 15%% x level of the damage to every other enemy within 2 + level blocks
enchantment.simple_tweaks.sunder.desc: A mace blow goes straight through a raised shield: the block is broken at once (that hit lands unprotected) and the shield loses 4 x level extra durability
enchantment.simple_tweaks.quake.desc: Interrupts a target that is using an item (bow draw, shield, potion, food); if the target is a player, that item also goes on a 1 s cooldown
enchantment.simple_tweaks.elemental_supr: (1) Your highest elemental affinity defends against all seven elements (maximum, never summed). (2) Its own mitigation zone: 4.5%% per total level (90%% at 20 levels), applied separately from the affinity (98%% total, never 100%%); this zone also covers damage no element claims (a plain swing), except true/venom/reflection damage. (3) Every hit carries an extra 5%% of its damage as an elemental conversion (the hit itself is not reduced), once per 10 total levels (2 at a full set), random element, can start a reaction. (4) Every reaction that hits you is remembered, capacity = total level / 2 (max 10); your next hit replays all of them, each at 40%% of that hit. (5) Attachment and reaction ICDs are shortened by 1 - total level / 20: at a full set (20 levels) both collapse to a single tick. (6) Counter: every elemental hit you take is answered by the element that counters it, attached to the attacker at 0.5 units (an active hit applies 1 unit), reflects 4%% x total level of that hit (80%% at a full set) and locks the attacker's healing for total level ticks (20 ticks = 1 s at a full set) - not triggered when the attacker also wears Elemental Supremacy
Level-up chance when hitting a player (%%)
Level-up chance when hurt by a player (%%)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.feather_fall.d: Fall damage is reduced by 20%% per level (80%% at IV). Does not cancel the fall, and stacks with the enchantments that do
enchantment.simple_tweaks.fleetfoot.desc: Movement speed +6%% per level while worn (III = +18%%). Removed the moment the boots come off
enchantment.simple_tweaks.bountiful.desc: Breaking crops or leaves has a 15%%-per-level chance to double the whole drop list (fortune and silk-touch results included)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.aqua_worker.de: Mining speed underwater is multiplied by 1 + level (IV exactly cancels the vanilla divide-by-5 penalty). Nothing happens on dry land
enchantment.simple_tweaks.deft.desc: Attack speed +8%% per level (III = +24%%), which shortens the swing interval from 0.625 s to 0.504 s
enchantment.simple_tweaks.gleaner.desc: Mining iron/gold/copper ore has a 10%%-per-level chance to also drop one nugget-sized item (iron nugget, gold nugget, raw copper)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.hamstring.desc: Hits have a 40%% + 10%%-per-level chance to apply Slowness I for 3 s (refreshes, never stacks)
enchantment.simple_tweaks.shield_bash.de: Blocking a melee hit knocks the attacker back and deals 2 + 2 x level true damage (ignores armour and never crits). Projectiles do not trigger it
enchantment.simple_tweaks.riposte.desc: After being hit in melee, your next hit within 3 s deals +15%%-per-level damage, then the charge is spent
enchantment.simple_tweaks.first_strike.d: The first hit on a target that is still at full health deals +12%%-per-level damage
enchantment.simple_tweaks.devour.desc: Every kill feeds the weapon by one stack: +2%% final damage per stack, up to 5 x level stacks (III = 15 stacks, +30%%). Dying halves them. The stacks stay on the weapon, not on the player
enchantment.simple_tweaks.multitude.desc: A reaction you trigger has a 15%% + 10%%-per-level chance to be replicated onto every other enemy within 6 + 2 x level blocks: they all receive the trigger element and the reaction's own damage
enchantment.simple_tweaks.karma.desc: Each attack you land (elemental riders, reactions and damage-over-time ticks do not count) resets the karma pool to 20%% + 10%% x effective level of that hit. The pool lasts floor(5 + effective level) seconds and cancels incoming damage 1:1 (before armour reduction) for at most floor(effective level) hits, then it is spent. maxLevel 16 = four pieces at IV; effective level = sum of all four / 4
enchantment.simple_tweaks.resonance_core: Every elemental reaction you trigger adds one Resonance stack to the target (cap 2 + level, III = 5 stacks, 10 s). Each stack makes your elemental damage against it +4%% (5 stacks = +20%%); once the stacks are full, your next elemental hit is a guaranteed crit (x2) and consumes them
Your water reactions (Vaporize / Electro-Charged / Bloom / Purify) turn lunar: 20%%+10%% x level (III = 50%%) of that reaction resolves as Lunar damage - ignores armour, can crit (15%%+10%% x level chance, x1.5) and grants one Moonlight stack (max 5, 10 s, +5%% Lunar damage each). Each reaction also gets its own rider: Vaporize -> Moonmist (target takes +25%% Lunar damage for 6 s); Electro-Charged -> Moonarc (40%% to the nearest other enemy within 6 blocks); Bloom -> Moonseed (blooms after 1.5 s, 40%% within 3 blocks, heals you 20%%); Purify -> Mooncleanse (strips one debuff from you, or x1.5 when you have none). Reactions between other elements are unaffected. The floating reaction label reads "Lunar <reaction>" Also +2.5 base attack damage per level.
Your frost reactions (Melt / Vanish / Overload / Eclipse / Freeze / Brittle) turn stellar: 15%%+10%% x level (III = 45%%) of that reaction resolves as Stellar damage - always crits (x1.5) and splashes 50%% of it to other enemies within 4 blocks. Each reaction also gets its own rider: Melt -> Starbonfire (that instance is x1.8); Vanish -> Starveil (a shield worth the instance); Overload -> Stardetonation (35%% to everything within 4 blocks, knocked back); Eclipse -> Startheft (steals one buff, or x1.3 when there is none); Freeze -> Starseal (heal lock 3 s); Brittle -> Starcrack (+10%% from follower hits for 5 s). Reactions between other elements are unaffected. The floating reaction label reads "Star <reaction>" Also +2.5 base attack damage per level.
enchantment.simple_tweaks.sun_blessing.d: Your fire and light reactions (Sanctify / Scorch / Annihilate / Burn / Extinguish / Quicken) turn solar: 20%%+10%% x level (III = 50%%) of that reaction resolves as Solar damage - ignores armour, never crits, but +50%% against the undead. Every rider here is output: Sanctify -> Radiance (the same instance lands again 1 s later); Scorch -> Sear (15%%/s for 5 s); Annihilate -> Doom (marked 6 s - if it dies in that window, 60%% bursts over 5 blocks); Burn -> Scorched Ground (6 s, 10%%/s to enemies within 3 blocks); Extinguish -> Embers (three sparks in half a second, 50%% each, 150%% total); Quicken -> Corona (every solar instance is x1.75 for 6 s, this one included). Reactions between other elements are unaffected. The floating reaction label reads "Solar <reaction>" Also +2.5 base attack damage per level.
